strategy: GPU XGBoost meta-label filter for BTC-shock-to-ETH events

selection.rule: on 2024-2025 require positive return, at least eight trades, at least half of months positive, and max drawdown no worse than 35%; rank by 25% month coverage, positive months, worst month, return, and drawdown

decision.reason: No meta-label configuration passed development selection; the highest-ranked fallback diagnostic also failed confirmation and cost stress.

limitations: 2026 has been viewed in prior studies and is not a fresh independent holdout.
The sparse event sample is small relative to ordinary bar-level ML datasets.
Liquidation, market impact, exchange failure, and shared margin are not modeled.
